security_notes.state_files: Terraform/OpenTofu state files contain sensitive infrastructure data including credentials, IP addresses, and resource IDs. Critical to prevent exposure.
security_notes.workspace_protection: Protected workspaces (production, prod, main) must block destructive operations. Verify protection mechanism cannot be bypassed.
security_notes.credential_storage: Verify .env files, terraform.tfvars, and state files are properly gitignored and not tracked in repository.
security_notes.audit_logging: All state-changing operations must be logged to tofu_operations.log with proper permissions (600).
security_notes.command_injection: Server executes CLI commands via subprocess - verify input sanitization and command construction security.
security_notes.confirmation_tokens: Auto-approve operations require confirmation_token matching workspace name - verify this cannot be bypassed.
security_notes.operation_log_protection: Operation log may contain workspace names and operation details - ensure proper file permissions.
security_notes.mcp_security: MCP server has CLI access - ensure it runs with minimal required permissions and cannot be exploited for privilege escalation.

risk_assessment.data_sensitivity: HIGH - State files contain credentials and sensitive data
risk_assessment.blast_radius: HIGH - Can create, modify, destroy cloud resources
risk_assessment.automation_risk: MEDIUM - Automated operations with safety gates

recommended_actions: Verify all state files and credentials are gitignored
Audit operation log for unauthorized activities
Scan for hardcoded credentials in code
Check file permissions on operation log
